description: This file contains a Java class 'MessageDigestPasswordEncoder' implementing a custom password encoder for the Hono project. It uses MessageDigest and Base64 encoding to hash passwords with salts, supporting configurable hash algorithms.

classes.name: MessageDigestPasswordEncoder
classes.description: A custom implementation of Spring Security's PasswordEncoder that hashes passwords using a specified MessageDigest algorithm with salt.

methods.name: MessageDigestPasswordEncoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the encoder with a specific hash function and an optional SecureRandom instance.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Creates a salted hash for a raw password using the specified hash function.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Verifies whether a raw password matches an encoded hashed password.

methods.name: digest
methods.description: Generates a salted hash of a password using the specified hash function.
